attr.title: Crossy Road
attr.desc: Testing candidate 0.2.0-rc1: Android Crossy Road 4.5.0, native SDL controller integration, offline local saves and haptics. Verified device scope: RG35XX-H/KNULLI; other CFWs need testing.
attr.inst: Copy your exact crossy-road-4-5-0.apk to ports/crossyroad and launch Crossy Road. The launcher automatically verifies and prepares the APK, then starts the game; no second script or handheld compiler is required. SHA-256: 1ad8bed1353b36a953c020c1562a519adceda02e4b4e98afa8eaf0db87643afb.
